FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 2
Pg. 33 As a reflection of the Unity of God - a neces- sary attribute of the Creator, all things tend to unity. By the laws of gravity "or by nat- uralinstinct, by love or by the laws of Christian Charity - each and all from the lowest to the highest tend to form one creation: each con- tributing to the perfection of the whole and no one independent of its neighbor creature. The material creation supporting the intellectual, and spiritual and these united, bound together by love and drawn by charity to an ineffeble unity or union with God. Hence the expressive word, universe which word, univers, litterally means turning or tending to one," and in its fullest sense is applied to all creation.
Pg. 34 "There was a marriage at Cana - and the Mother of Jesus was there." Jn. Il-1
The holy Gospel of Today brings us at once to subject - really beautiful and sublime of "Christian Marriage: a subject that the Church has ever proclaimed holy - typical of the love of Christ for His Church - fundamentally neces- sary for every kind of true progress and human prosperity. Not that everyone must marry who wishes to have peace in this world & gain Heaven in the next, for that would be contrary to the counsels of Jesus Christ and His Church; But that marriage be held as it ought to be and is as something sacred, something of divine institution, to be prepared for with purity and holiness of heart and embraced in a Christian manner. That those who do embrace it, do so
